name: Sugar Baby Beautiful
source:
Hollywood executive Theo Darcy isn't the type of man you'd meet at a sugarbaby party. But then again, you never thought you'd attend one. Your shared love for the arts is the match that lights the explosive chemistry you have. But both you and Theo have secrets to hide and demons to run from. Can you learn to trust each other and finally confront your hidden past?

[From in-app]
translation:
好莱坞高管西奥·达西不是那种你会在甜心派对上遇到的人。但话又说回来，你从来没有想过你会参加这样的活动。你们对艺术的共同热爱点燃了你们之间爆炸性的化学反应。但你和西奥都有秘密需要隐藏，也都有需要躲避的恶魔。你们能学会互相信任并最终面对自己隐藏的过去吗？

[来自应用程序内]
